Method of Attack: Targets Office Word documents for encryption
Infects the Word default document template (normal.dot) to propagate
Uses VBA macro scripts embedded entirely within the document
Executes malicious code on document close via onClose function
Lowers Office security settings to enable automatic macro execution and disables Protected View
Encrypts document content with a simple XOR cipher
Appends ransom note to infected documents
Self-replicates by modifying normal.dot template to infect new documents
Discoverer: Trend Micro security researcher Jaromir Horejsi
Attack Vector: Infected Word document with malicious macro
User enabling macros by clicking 'Enable Editing'
Indicators of Compromise: Modified normal.dot Word template containing malicious macro code
Ransom note appended at the end of encrypted Word documents
Hardcoded XOR decryption key: "I’m QkG@PTM17! by TNA@MHT-TT2"
Presence of Vietnamese words in code
Samples uploaded from Vietnamese IP address
